SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notice n JOIN employee e ON n.emp_no = e.emp_no WHERE n.notice_status != 'UNVISIBLE'
AND n.notice_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND n.notice_content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND e.emp_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND (n.notice_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR n.notice_content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

SELECT n.notice_no AS noticeNo, n.notice_title AS noticeTitle, n.notice_content AS noticeContent, n.created_at AS createdAt, n.notice_status AS noticeStatus, n.view_count AS viewCount, n.emp_no AS empNo, e.emp_name AS empName FROM notice n JOIN employee e ON n.emp_no = e.emp_no WHERE n.notice_status != 'UNVISIBLE'
AND n.notice_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND n.notice_content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND e.emp_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND (n.notice_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR n.notice_content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY CASE WHEN n.notice_status = 'IMPORTANT' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, n.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT N.NOTICE_NO AS noticeNo, N.NOTICE_TITLE AS noticeTitle, N.NOTICE_CONTENT AS noticeContent, N.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, N.NOTICE_STATUS AS noticeStatus, N.VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, N.EMP_NO AS empNo, E.EMP_NAME AS empName FROM notice N JOIN employee E ON N.EMP_NO = E.EMP_NO WHERE N.NOTICE_NO = #{noticeNo}
